q: How do I work out a passenger ropeway's CO2 per passenger?
title: Ropeway CO2 per passenger
short: Read the drive station's electricity meter for the month, multiply by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25 and divide by passengers carried. Backup diesel for rescue drives is Scope 1. Off season days raise the per passenger figure because the line runs nearly empty.
audience: Ropeway and cable car operators at tourist and pilgrim sites

ul: Diesel for the backup drive and generator tests.

p: Running speed and empty cabins in low season. Report monthly figures, not one annual average.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
